description: Implementation of a dynamic stack data structure with functions for creation, manipulation, sorting, searching, copying, and freeing stack objects, used internally in OpenSSL or similar cryptographic libraries.

methods.name: sk_new
methods.description: Creates a new stack with optional comparison function.

methods.name: sk_new_null
methods.description: Creates a new empty stack with no comparison function.

methods.name: sk_num
methods.description: Returns the number of elements in the stack.

methods.name: sk_zero
methods.description: Resets the stack, clearing its contents.

methods.name: sk_value
methods.description: Retrieves the element at a given index.

methods.name: sk_set
methods.description: Sets the element at a given index.

methods.name: sk_free
methods.description: Frees the stack and its data.

methods.name: sk_pop_free_ex
methods.description: Frees the stack and calls a custom free function on each element.

methods.name: sk_pop_free
methods.description: Frees the stack with a legacy free function.

methods.name: sk_insert
methods.description: Inserts an element at a specified position.

methods.name: sk_delete
methods.description: Deletes and returns the element at a specified position.

methods.name: sk_delete_ptr
methods.description: Deletes the first occurrence of a specific pointer.

methods.name: sk_delete_if
methods.description: Deletes elements based on a predicate function.

methods.name: sk_find
methods.description: Finds an element in the stack, optionally returning its index.

methods.name: sk_shift
methods.description: Removes and returns the first element.

methods.name: sk_push
methods.description: Adds an element to the end of the stack.

methods.name: sk_pop
methods.description: Removes and returns the last element.

methods.name: sk_dup
methods.description: Creates a shallow copy of the stack.

methods.name: sk_sort
methods.description: Sorts the stack using a comparison function.

methods.name: sk_is_sorted
methods.description: Checks if the stack is sorted.

methods.name: sk_set_cmp_func
methods.description: Sets the comparison function for the stack.

methods.name: sk_deep_copy
methods.description: Creates a deep copy of the stack with element copying and freeing callbacks.
